dateRangePicker.$description: A date-range picker — the date window of the threads console's filter bar (staff Message Center). One bordered field, `‹ | [calendar icon + 'Aug 08, 2026 – Sep 08, 2026'] | ›`: the middle segment opens the calendar, the arrows step the WHOLE window back/forward by a month (the common case — 'last month', 'the month before' — is one click, no calendar). The panel is a dual-month calendar (two consecutive months side by side, each with month + year selects so a far-off window is two picks instead of a dozen arrow clicks), with Reset (back to the default window) and Apply in the footer; nothing filters until Apply, so a half-picked range never reloads the console. A `--single` one-month variant is for narrow containers (the mobile/tablet filters drawer); the dual panel stacks its months under 560px. Replaces the earlier ‹ start · period label · end › navigator, whose 'Current' label and two separate date fields cost width the console toolbar doesn't have. Built on the field + Popover recipes shared with the single DatePicker; day states extended with the range band.

height.$description: 40px = the base field height, so it lines up with the Selects/Search beside it in the console toolbar.

bg.$description: The locked-in field recipe: surface.dim fill, hairline border → strong on hover → focus blue.

divider.$description: Hairline between the prev arrow, the range field and the next arrow.

arrowWidth.$description: 32px-wide arrow segment (full field height) — the same 32 as the panel's paging arrows (header.navSize).

paddingX.$description: Inline padding of the middle range field.

value.$description: The range text, 'Mmm DD, YYYY – Mmm DD, YYYY'.

padding.$description: 16px — two months plus a footer is a bigger surface than the single DatePicker's 12px panel.

calendarGap.$description: Space between the two side-by-side months.

stackedGap.$description: Space between the months once they stack (< 560px).

navSize.$description: 32px paging arrow. Prev sits on the left month's outer edge, next on the right month's (both on the single variant); the inner sides keep an empty 32px spacer so the selects stay centred over their grid. Tokenized because the prototype once drifted to 30px.

select.$description: Month + year <select> pair — a compact 32px control in the field family (white, not surface.dim, because it sits inside the white panel).

paddingRight.$description: Room for the chevron (8px inset + 16px icon + 4px air).

size.$description: 36px square day cell (the prototype once drifted to 34px — this token is the one source).

rowGap.$description: Vertical gap between weeks; columns sit flush (0 gap) so the range reads as one continuous band.

todayBorder.$description: Today gets a hairline ring — a quiet 'you are here', distinct from the filled ends.

endsBg.$description: The start and end days fill solid.

rangeBg.$description: Days between start and end get a light primary wash.

outsideColor.$description: Days spilling in from the prev/next month — shown for grid shape, not pickable.

footer.$description: Reset (left) and Apply (right). Both ARE Buttons — Reset = Button secondary sm, Apply = Button primary sm — so their size and colours come from button.tokens.json, not from this file.
